# Cover letter for Northwind Traders

I am writing to apply for the Senior Product Designer role at Northwind Traders. I have spent six years designing tools for warehouse and shipping teams.

At my last company I led the redesign of a dispatch dashboard used by forty planners. The new layout cut the time to assign a route in half.

I would welcome the chance to talk about how I could help Northwind Traders ship clearer tools for its logistics teams.
